title: Ecology
subtitle: Who lives where, and why
summary: Twenty-nine reindeer were put on St Matthew Island in 1944. By 1963 there were six thousand, and three years later forty-two. Ecology is about numbers like those, and the course works through the classic cases that explain them: hares and lynx, Paine's sea stars, the finches of Daphne Major in a drought, the cod off Newfoundland. Branches go to ant colonies, the Salish Sea shore, Mount St Helens after 1980, and the dry side of the Cascades.
